introHtml: Salutepromos badge ID holders combine durability with a professional look, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate security, and daily employee identification. Choose from clear vinyl pouches, nylon neck wallets, or holders with bulldog clips for easy attachment. With multiple sizes and styles available, you can find the right fit for your badges, from standard 3" x 5" to larger 4" x 6" formats. Customize with your logo or messaging to reinforce brand visibility every time an ID is displayed.
